title: Historical V3 black screen and delayed first paint
statement: The earlier V3 preview could render a black screen or delay the shell; the durable lesson is that the primary interface must render before optional/heavy modules.
symptom: V3 opened with black/blank screen or waited on dependencies before showing the usable shell.
root_cause: Recovered evidence identifies an initially truncated HTML build and later blocking fonts/icons/scripts/heavy modules as contributors in the historical preview.
resolution: Repair truncated HTML and prioritize the shell using defer/lazy loading, non-blocking assets, feature loading and network timeouts.
prevention: Keep first paint independent from optional intelligence and remote services; do not block Home on heavy modules.
regression_test: Historical preview-v2 performance-shell/first-paint checks; on current main use the relevant performance/PWA/release gates when changing startup behavior.

title: Historical technical configurator returned zero OG configurations
statement: A technical configurator showed zero configurations when its OG data dependency had not been loaded before initialization.
symptom: Technical UI displayed 0 OG configurations despite configuration data existing.
root_cause: OG_DATA/core data was loaded after or independently from the configurator in the historical V3 flow.
resolution: Load the data dependency before the configurator and make dependency order explicit.
prevention: Technical modules must fail visibly on missing source data and tests must initialize the same dependency order as production.
regression_test: Technical/configuration tests must assert non-empty known fixture data only after the declared data dependency is loaded.

title: Historical close rate reached 48400 percent
statement: A historical close-rate calculation mixed sales from a broad CRM population with proposals from a narrower prospecting population, producing an impossible 48400 percent result.
root_cause: Numerator and denominator represented different commercial populations.
resolution: Attribute sales/proposals to the same filtered universe and constrain the semantic rate to a logically valid population.
prevention: Every conversion metric must document and test the population used by numerator and denominator.
regression_test: Metric tests must include unrelated historical sales and assert they do not affect a scoped prospecting close rate; close rate must not exceed 100% for the defined funnel.

title: Historical prospecting showed zero lists despite usable CRM views
statement: Prospecting became operationally empty when lists were treated as an isolated module instead of projections/collections over the CRM base.
symptom: Prospecting UI showed no useful lists while CRM already contained organized accounts/views.
root_cause: List UX was separated from the canonical CRM source and did not expose existing smart views as work sources.
resolution: Expose CRM views as sources for operational lists without duplicating companies.
prevention: Lists are collections over canonical CRM identity; never create a second company store to make a prospecting list.
regression_test: CRM/list integration tests should assert one company can appear in multiple operational lists without duplicating its canonical identity.

title: Silent revision conflict could overwrite local or remote work
statement: Revision conflicts require preserved local/remote state and explicit review; silent merge/resend is prohibited.
symptom: A stale client could conflict with newer server state and a naive merge/retry path risked hiding which work won.
root_cause: Treating optimistic-concurrency conflict as a retry/merge detail rather than a business-data review boundary.
resolution: Package 04R established revision-authoritative conflict handling, preserved local/remote comparison, durable auth-safe outbox and foreground reviewed delivery.
prevention: Never force-merge or auto-resend divergent commercial state; preserve both sides and require explicit resolution.
regression_test: npm run og:sync:conflict:test && npm run og:sync:conflict:ui:test && npm run og:sync:bridge:test

title: Excel repaired generated workbook structures
statement: A historical generated workbook opened with Excel recovery that removed an AutoFilter/table and a worksheet formula; the exact original serialization defect is not conclusively proven by recovered evidence.
symptom: Excel recovery log reported removed AutoFilter/table features and a removed formula.
root_cause: Not conclusively established. Recovered evidence supports a workbook-structure/compatibility problem, not a precise single serializer defect.
resolution: Current architecture isolates legacy XLSX handling and adds canonical template/import/export/builder tests; the specific historical repaired workbook has not been re-certified here.
prevention: Preserve canonical templates, formulas and manual fields; test generated workbooks structurally and perform a real Excel smoke test before declaring high-stakes exports certified.
regression_test: npm run og:spreadsheet:test && npm run og:spreadsheet-export:test && npm run og:spreadsheet-xlsx-builder:test; manual Excel open/repair-log check remains required for certification.

title: Call Intelligence real validation exposed audio and metric contract defects
statement: Real Call Intelligence validation required signed audio uploads to use raw binary, truck quantities to be recognized correctly, duplicate objection inflation to be prevented and synthetic TEST sessions to be excluded from production dashboards.
symptom: Real validation found upload/recognition/aggregation behavior that differed from the intended Call Intelligence contract.
root_cause: Integration assumptions were too permissive around signed upload body format, extraction normalization and metric inclusion.
resolution: Commit 39be4d18 hardened binary upload, quantity extraction, objection deduplication and production metric filtering.
prevention: Exercise Call Intelligence with real contract-shaped audio/transcript inputs and keep synthetic sessions explicitly segregated from production analytics.
regression_test: npm run og:call-intelligence:test plus the opt-in production runtime self-test when live validation is authorized.

title: Embedded faster-whisper fallback missed runtime dependency
statement: The embedded local faster-whisper fallback required an explicit runtime dependency that was missing from the first deployment path.
symptom: Local Whisper fallback could not complete its model download/runtime path reliably because a required Python dependency was absent.
root_cause: Runtime dependency contract omitted requests for the faster-whisper download/runtime path.
resolution: Commit af5469eb added the missing dependency and f4c2b3c6 added an end-to-end production runtime self-test over signed private audio → local transcription → trusted ingestion.
prevention: Pin runtime dependencies and validate the actual hosted fallback path, not only unit contracts.
regression_test: npm run og:call-intelligence:test and scripts/whisper-runtime-self-test.mjs in the authorized hosted environment.

title: Supabase remote schema and Edge Functions exceed versioned repository state
statement: The live Supabase backend is now reconstructable from reviewed Git evidence: the exact 25 recorded migrations, all 13 deployed Edge Function sources, and a catalog-derived bootstrap supplement for eight CRM tables that had existed outside recorded migration history.
symptom: Live Supabase inventory showed 25 applied migrations and 13 active Edge Functions while the repository contained only 4 migration files and source for 2 Edge Functions.
root_cause: Backend changes were applied remotely across earlier implementation cycles without all generated/applied migration SQL and deployed Edge Function source being backfilled into the canonical Git history.
resolution: SUPABASE-00S recovered the original SQL stored in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations, restored all active Edge Function source, separated the unapplied Auth/Organization pilot, reconstructed the eight untracked live CRM tables as an explicit recovery bootstrap, and added a rollback-only disposable Supabase replay. The dedicated Supabase Canonical Replay passed end-to-end on 2026-10-04.
prevention: Every future Supabase structural change must be versioned before production application and must preserve the canonical replay gate. Live-only schema/function state is prohibited; pre-flight compares live inventory with supabase/migrations, supabase/functions and the documented recovery bootstrap boundary.
regression_test: GitHub Actions workflow `Supabase Canonical Replay` plus `npm run og:supabase:recovery:test` and `npm run og:supabase:replay-safety:test`; structural Supabase work remains blocked when this gate is red.

title: Structural convergence blocked by missing checkout and unreachable proxy
statement: Structural work must prove its execution route before repository-local implementation. Local Git transport, GitHub provider access and hosted runtime access are separate capabilities; a failure in one must trigger classified fallback rather than repeated retries or false project conclusions.
symptom: CONVERGENCE-01 Stage 0 entered a cloud workspace with no usable repository checkout. git ls-remote could not reach GitHub because the configured proxy endpoint on port 8080 was unavailable, while the GitHub connector continued to read repository refs successfully.
root_cause: The execution plan assumed a usable local checkout/Git transport before capability preflight. Provider access existed but was not treated as a distinct fallback route, so the task spent cycles confirming an environment blocker instead of establishing remote-safe project state immediately.
resolution: Created a dedicated Environment Guardian Skill, routed Builder Brain/Dev through an environment gate, created the convergence branch remotely from the exact #110 SHA using the GitHub provider, and moved volatile state into a persistent convergence checkpoint. Local integration/testing remains gated on a valid worktree.
prevention: For every STANDARD/STRUCTURAL task: capability inventory first; validate checkout and transport once; classify proxy/network/auth separately; use provider fallback for explicitly authorized safe remote setup; never infer auth failure before transport; never retry an unchanged failed path; block before implementation if required tests cannot run. For STANDARD/STRUCTURAL work whose Definition of Done includes remote push, prove separate READ TRANSPORT GATE and REMOTE WRITE GATE before accumulating local commits; prefer git push --dry-run on the safe working branch. Checkout/fetch success does not prove push authentication. Classify read-success/write-auth-failure as ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKER: GIT_WRITE_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE; inspect gh auth status and use gh auth setup-git when authenticated, never print secrets, and stop early if interactive login is needed. Injected GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN can override persisted GitHub CLI credentials. On HTTP 401 also test gh auth status with GH_TOKEN= GITHUB_TOKEN=; never reveal token values or delete user credentials automatically. If the injected token fails but stored login is valid with permissions.push=true, configure gh and run Git authentication/push/fetch with those variables temporarily empty. Read auth and write auth differ; dry-run is only preflight, and a structural publication REMOTE WRITE GATE is PASS only after real push plus fetched LOCAL==REMOTE verification.
regression_test: Human/machine preflight must report CHECKOUT, GIT_TRANSPORT, GITHUB_PROVIDER, PROXY, AUTH, TOOLCHAIN, TEST_CAPABILITY and SAFE_TO_CONTINUE before structural implementation. The next CONVERGENCE-01 session must load dutra-environment-guardian before local Git operations.

title: Confirmed Mesa outcome lost on immediate refresh during sync debounce
statement: A local-first outcome must be recoverable before the UI confirms success or advances. Reuse the canonical outbox instead of waiting for debounced transport.
symptom: Browser smoke saved a new next action, then immediate reload recovered the older remote value.
root_cause: Mesa persisted localStorage but deferred remote PUT for450ms without first writing the existing recovery outbox; bootstrap had no pending payload and applied stale remote state.
resolution: Mesa awaits OG_SYNC_BRIDGE.queueState(currentSyncPayload()) after canonical outcome mutations and before success/advance; submission latch prevents repeated mutation.
prevention: Durably enqueue supported operations in the existing outbox before acknowledging them; preserve explicit conflict/review ownership and do not create another sync store.
regression_test: npm run og:meu-dia:browser:test — immediate refresh, double submission, offline/reconnect, HTTP409 conflict survival across refresh.

title: Empty filtered prospect queue retained stale actionable focus
statement: Focused prospect identity must belong to its active canonical queue. A valid normalized session additionally requires exact session/member/company membership; zero local eligible items cannot leave an old local focus actionable.
symptom: Filtered queue empty but focused UI displayed 1 / 0 and offered actions for the previously selected CRM record.
root_cause: Focus selected by lookup in the complete CRM without verifying filtered queue membership; Math.max masked an invalid position.
resolution: Readonly selection reconciliation derives valid current/first eligible/null from current queue on every render; focused panel capture rejects obsolete/disconnected controls before actions.
prevention: Validate selection and position against current eligible membership, including before stale UI actions. Never hide inconsistent state with a visual patch.
regression_test: scripts/test_prospecting_workspace_browser.mjs: one-to-zero, invalid selected-to-valid replacement, zero-to-items and captured stale WA/tel/Review/delay/save controls remain inert.

title: Optional Service Worker readiness blocked foreground reconnect
statement: Optional Background Sync registration must not hold the foreground sync write lock or delay visible pending-state delivery after a durable outbox write.
symptom: After an offline debounced PUT failed, reconnect stayed busy and skipped outbox replay; the Meu Dia browser timed out waiting for sync=ok.
root_cause: runScheduledServerSync awaited navigator.serviceWorker.ready while serverSyncInFlight was true. Without a registered worker that promise can remain pending indefinitely, so finally never released the lock and reconnect flush returned false. Timing-dependent earlier successes reconnected before the failed debounced PUT reached this path.
resolution: After awaiting durable existing outbox persistence, register optional Background Sync in a detached caught promise. Existing finally releases the write lock and authenticated foreground replay/actual server acknowledgement determine OK.
prevention: Keep optional background capability promises outside critical sync lifecycle. Verify pending write, actual request failure, remote acknowledgement, queue clearance, error and explicit conflict review rather than only a status label.
regression_test: scripts/test_sync_reconnect_browser.mjs: Service Worker blocked, failed offline PUT and durable queue before reconnect, genuine ACK/empty outbox/OK, empty reconnect, HTTP503 retains pending/no retry loop, actual HTTP409 review and explicit resolution, bounded listeners.

title: Late Call AI response or discarded session contaminates active context
statement: Presentation continuations retain captured account/session/recording/generation; reset/discard invalidates old requests and clears draft metadata/suggestions. No inferred CRM facts are automatic.
symptom: A status/transcript request completed after selection B and assigned A payload to current B recording; permission, upload, polling and preparation shared mutable session reads. Reset left notes/signals/adaptation from prior session.
root_cause: Post-await continuations read current mutable UI selection/session rather than captured operation identity, while discard cleared only part of its transient draft.
resolution: Validate captured owner after awaits and before continuation/render, stop stale returned tracks, bound/latch polls, validate response identifiers and clear draft/origin/signals/suggestions on new session.
prevention: Treat every asynchronous continuation and retained DOM handler as bound to its originating entity and session generation.
regression_test: scripts/test_call_ai_workspace_browser.mjs: A→B/A→B→A/reset, late preparation/permission/upload/status/manual/Whisper; new draft contains no discarded notes/signals.

title: Local Call AI confirmation preceded normalized command and suppressed retry
statement: Normalized reviewed command must ACK before confirmed local projection; durable current outbox must complete before success/advance. Failures retain explicit retry without duplicating identity/history.
symptom: Rejected normalized save left local interaction/session registered; next attempt was blocked as already saved. Missing normalized module was treated as local account fallback.
root_cause: Local mutation/idempotency marker and success UI occurred before recordCallResult, with a combined missing-client/unlinked-account guard.
resolution: Keep canonical RPC and stable externalId first, distinguish missing module as error, latch submissions, preserve review on command failure, await existing durable outbox and lock acknowledged fields for idempotent completion after storage error.
prevention: Do not confirm or advance a reviewed result before the required owner ACK and recovery boundary; module absence never changes entity ownership.
regression_test: scripts/test_call_ai_workspace_browser.mjs: failed/missing-module zero confirmed interaction; same-ID retry; real IndexedDB transaction abort after ACK; one interaction/event; human edits prevail; requested proposal is not sent.

title: Reconnect event lost while prior foreground sync releases its lock
statement: An explicit reconnect blocked by the existing foreground lock is consumed once after release with current gates revalidated. Errors alone do not trigger retries or fake OK.
symptom: Deterministic online event during a held post-write queueState left the existing sync status pending after lock release; original 30-second OK assertion timed out.
root_cause: flushQueuedState returned false while serverSyncInFlight and discarded reconnect intent; finally released lock without resuming it.
resolution: One transient explicit-reconnect intent in the same controller is consumed/cleared after lock release; revalidate lock after IndexedDB read and online/conflict/review gates before resuming existing loadSharedState.
prevention: Lock release must reconcile explicitly deferred events; optional worker readiness never holds foreground delivery, and failure must not create a retry loop.
regression_test: scripts/test_sync_reconnect_browser.mjs holds actual durable second queue write through native reconnect, releases, then asserts actual ACK/outbox clearance/OK; 503 no loop, durable409 explicit review, bounded listeners.

title: Held remote GET overwrote newer durable technical draft
statement: A remote read may apply only to the unchanged local generation and current recovery gates; canonical operations are data even with no CRM/history/events.
symptom: Synthetic real-function repro held GET, completed technical save and durable queue, then delivered old remote operations: scheduled PUT sent no draft, cleared queue and showed OK. A separate operations-only pull reported OK without applying the remote draft or seeding a local recovered draft.
root_cause: loadSharedState applied post-await GET without checking local generation/outbox/foreground writer/review, and detected data only in leads/history/activityEvents rather than all existing operations collections.
resolution: Capture/recheck current generation after awaits and before apply; reject stale reads when queued/writer/conflict/review state changes. Determine local/remote content from OG_OPERATIONS_MODEL collection counts and reuse current pull/seed writer.
prevention: Bind async remote reads to the local generation; an older read cannot replace acknowledged local recovery. Include every existing canonical collection in presence checks without adding a store/schema.
regression_test: scripts/test_technical_context_browser.mjs holds actual loopback GET during durable save, verifies exact draft/outbox through response/refresh/later real PUT ACK; remote operations-only pull and local operations-only seed assert actual canonical records and zero fabricated CRM/proposal facts.

title: Old PUT ACK erased a newer durable outbox intention
statement: Remote ACK retires only the exact captured recovery intention atomically; an ACK for old work cannot clear a later durable save or certify current OK.
symptom: Real-function repro serialized OLD in scheduled/reconnect PUT, durably saved NEW while awaiting response, then OLD ACK left state OLD+NEW with queue=null. Refresh before the next retained timer could lose NEW. Initial compare-to-wire variant also left older queued recovery pending when the sent current state was legitimately newer.
root_cause: Unconditional clearQueuedState preceded generation handling; generation-only checks left a gap during asynchronous delete. Comparing the queue to current wire payload conflated the prior recovery intention with the newer canonical snapshot being sent.
resolution: Serialize immutable current wire payload; separately deep-clone the exact queued body under lock, using explicit null if absent. ACK compare/delete occurs in one IndexedDB readwrite transaction. Generation/mismatch preserves the newer queue and resumes existing controller timer; explicit reviewed send uses its durably queued review snapshot.
prevention: Separate immutable sent snapshot, captured outbox intention and current generation. Atomic expected-value removal must preserve a changed queue, including changes during awaited cleanup and queue appearance after a captured absence; only matching current acknowledgement yields OK.
regression_test: scripts/test_technical_context_browser.mjs holds real scheduled/reconnect/human-review PUT ACK while NEW is durably saved, blocks next PUT, refreshes inside the ACK gap and proves NEW survives to later real ACK; prior outbox plus newer canonical startup recovery proves successful current delivery without stale queue/false conflict.

project_scope: DUTRA OS / isolated preview reality check
title: Client-origin technical navigation must carry canonical identity
statement: Client-origin technical navigation switched tabs without selecting the originating canonical lead. The existing technical selector and dirty-draft confirmation now receive that identity from both the sales card and client sheet. No new CRM, context owner or technical engine.
root_cause: Navigation-only handler omitted existing controller client selection.
resolution: Resolve canonical lead and dispatch existing technical client change after opening the workspace; retain dirty-draft confirmation.
prevention: Test cross-module identity continuity through actual DOM actions, reviewed outcome, follow-up and exact technical quote handoff.
symptom: Technical workspace opened without originating customer selected
